name: use-attachments
title: useAttachmentUpload
description: useAttachmentUpload: the attachments block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the attachments block (`npx better-supabase add attachments`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/attachments.
